name: single roster preserves rank and excludes removed moderators
input: stage 1 audit log with remove and permission checks
test:
logs = 'nora,add,SYSTEM,11
owen,add,nora,12
priya,add,nora,13
quinn,add,owen,14
priya,remove,nora,15'
queries = [['can', 'nora', 'owen'], ['can', 'owen', 'nora'], ['can', 'owen', 'quinn'], ['list']]
assert process_queries(1, logs, queries) == [True, False, True, ['nora', 'owen', 'quinn']]

name: communities keep independent access times
input: stage 2 audit log for gardening and photography
test:
logs = 'gardening,nora,add,SYSTEM,21
gardening,owen,add,nora,22
gardening,priya,add,nora,23
photography,riley,add,SYSTEM,24
photography,owen,add,riley,25
gardening,priya,remove,nora,26'
queries = [['list', 'gardening'], ['list', 'photography'], ['can', 'gardening', 'nora', 'owen'], ['can', 'photography', 'owen', 'riley']]
assert process_queries(2, logs, queries) == [['nora', 'owen'], ['riley', 'owen'], True, False]

name: demotion and re-add both replace effective access time
input: stage 3 audit log with a demotion then a re-add
test:
logs = 'gaming,lea,add,SYSTEM,5
gaming,mo,add,lea,7
gaming,zoe,add,lea,9
gaming,mo,demote,lea,10
gaming,zoe,remove,lea,11
gaming,zoe,add,lea,12'
queries = [['list', 'gaming'], ['can', 'gaming', 'lea', 'mo'], ['can', 'gaming', 'mo', 'zoe']]
assert process_queries(3, logs, queries) == [['lea', 'mo', 'zoe'], True, True]
